root_causes_addressed.name: Compound Demands Sub-Decomposed in Single Clauses
root_causes_addressed.failure_mechanism: Questions with multiple interdependent operational aspects (states, multi-actions, error conditions) in single grammatical clauses collapsed into a single generic demand, allowing partial responses covering only one aspect to achieve FULL coverage and DIRECT.

root_causes_addressed.name: Technical Verbs in Autobiographical and Historical Anecdotes
root_causes_addressed.failure_mechanism: Action verbs in historical trivia ('escrito por Igor Sysoev') or personal declarations ('já usei em produção') activated broad verb-stem matchers, promoting background context to an operative solution.

root_causes_addressed.name: Circularity Bypassing Static Stem Lists via Morphological Inflexions
root_causes_addressed.failure_mechanism: Tautological circular reasoning used legitimate Portuguese morphological variations (noun-verb nominalization divergence, e.g. 'compressão' vs 'comprimindo') that bypassed static stem tuples.

root_causes_addressed.name: Hardcoded Conflation between EVASIVE and UNKNOWN
root_causes_addressed.failure_mechanism: Hardcoded rule in evaluate_relevance routed prop.is_evasive to UNKNOWN instead of INSUFFICIENT, violating canonical rubrics where evasive answers lack evaluable evidence.

root_causes_addressed.name: Thematic Proximity and Institutional Context Misclassified as Direct
root_causes_addressed.failure_mechanism: Unstemmed declaration/trivia markers failed to trigger on slight phrasing variations, allowing thematic adjacency without mechanism to be promoted to DIRECT.

root_causes_addressed.name: Cross-Demand Satisfaction via Isolated Coincident Tokens
root_causes_addressed.failure_mechanism: Multi-aspect demands were extracted, but the nexus checker matched isolated keywords in the response to multiple demands, allowing one response proposition to satisfy independent demands without 1-to-1 evidence.

root_causes_addressed.name: Representation Invariance Asymmetry in Colloquial and Passive Antitheses
root_causes_addressed.failure_mechanism: Colloquial and passive voice formulations of destructive actions bypassed formal imperative regexes and activated operative verbs, causing asymmetric classification between equivalent formulations.

root_causes_addressed.name: Polarity and Preventive Safeguard Scope
root_causes_addressed.failure_mechanism: Overpenalization of technical absence or disjunction boundaries without semantic fallback; preserved positive preventive safeguard behavior.

architecture_summary.approved_option: Option 2: Decomposed Propositional Graph with Explicit Semantic Contracts

components.name: SemanticIntentAndDemandExtractor
components.responsibility: Extract intent, primary demands, required operational aspects, and dependency relations from questions without relying solely on explicit interrogative conjunctions.

components.name: PropositionDiscourseFilter
components.responsibility: Classify discourse genre into 7 categories (OPERATIVE_SOLUTION, HISTORICAL_TRIVIA, PERSONAL_DECLARATION, MONITORING_TELEMETRY, DESTRUCTIVE_ANTITHESIS, EVASIVE_FILLER, IGNORANCE) before assessing technical operativity.

components.name: MorphologicalCircularityAnalyzer
components.responsibility: Analyze morphological cognates and semantic informativeness graph, treating nominalizations and verbs as shared stems to detect circular tautologies regardless of inflection.

components.name: DemandPropositionNexusBipartiteMatcher
components.responsibility: Perform bipartite 1-to-1 matching between demands and propositions, preventing a single proposition from satisfying distinct independent demands without explicit joint mechanism.

components.name: StrictOntologyRelevanceAggregator
components.responsibility: Single source of truth for the 7 canonical classes, enforcing strict rules: EVASIVE -> INSUFFICIENT, tautology -> UNKNOWN, DIRECT -> 100% aspects solved.

implementation_increments.focus: Multi-aspect demand extraction, state machine detection, action/compensation coordination without explicit conjunctions.
1-to-1 bipartite nexus matching, elimination of diffuse token cross-satisfaction, decoupling demands from propositions.
Discourse genre classification (autobiographical, trivia, telemetry) and unified cognate-based circularity detection.
Robust antithesis detection across colloquial/passive forms, boundary correction routing EVASIVE to INSUFFICIENT.
Single source of truth aggregation, audit trail generation, regression validation across 1038 unit tests and 15 harness tests.
